description: This Java source file defines the BinaryStreamHandler class, which is a component within the OpenMRS platform responsible for handling binary complex observations. It provides functionality to retrieve and save binary data associated with observations, specifically stored as input streams on the file system. The class implements methods to support specific views of data and manages the underlying storage interactions.

classes.name: BinaryStreamHandler
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that handles storing and retrieving binary complex observations via file system storage, supporting specific views and managing complex data within OpenMRS.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieve the binary data associated with an observation based on the specified view, supporting only the RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Return the list of supported views for this handler, currently only RAW_VIEW.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Save the complex data (binary stream) of an observation to persistent storage, updating the observation with the storage key.
